content: Proceed with t5 only. Preserve existing app.js behavior and unrelated changes. Integrate voice into the existing thread and do not expose secrets.

Captain review found concrete frontend integration defects; t9 is ready and must be repaired before final integration. Please claim/complete t9 now. Use a single ES-module interface and one microphone button/media ownership model.

Frontend t3 sends binary PCM16 to same-origin /ws/live and expects binary PCM16 24k output plus JSON {type:'transcript', role:'user'|'assistant', text, final}, {type:'audio.interrupted'}, {type:'state',state}, and safe {type:'error',message}. Please align backend events if possible.
When t8 becomes ready after docs, do not start validation until t10 continuous-session/readiness repair is completed. Check team status first; then validate the repaired final state.
